subject: Trading
title: The Sunk Cost Trap
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Sunk Cost Trap.

hook.text: You've spent months researching this stock. It's down 40%. Selling would 'waste' all that research. So you hold.

buildup.text: The sunk cost fallacy makes people continue a losing course of action to justify past effort or investment.

discovery.text: Time, money, and effort already spent are gone regardless. Only the future potential matters now.

twist.text: Institutions fall for this too. Funds hold underperformers because admitting a mistake hurts their reputation.

climax.text: The question isn't 'How much have I invested in this?' It's 'Is this the best place for my money right now?'

punchline.text: Spent money is spent. Only tomorrow's gains count.

quiz.question: What is the sunk cost trap in trading?
options: Holding a losing position to justify past effort already spent
